top.title: Clean Slate
top.desc: Clean Slate is a first-person cleaning game where you blast mud off with water guns, mow wild lawns and bag the litter. Clean houses, a fire station, a football stadium, an alien crash site and a dinosaur park.

top.title: Squishy: Grow Your 240 Toys
top.desc: Collect stress-relief squishies at your own pace! Open the box, grab a random baby squishy, and merge matching ones to make them grow and transform into new toys.

top.title: Coin Bounty
top.desc: Play Coin Bounty free in your browser on Kongregate. No downloads or installs—just click and start playing online.

top.title: Storm Wars
top.desc: Try Storm Wars on Kongregate and play free online in your browser. Quick to load, easy to jump back in anytime.

top.title: 204Snake DEMO

top.desc: Peek Corners and Ghosts In This First Person Horror Arcade (BOooo!)

top.title: Party Pooper 2

top.descZh: 与「便便」来一次近距离接触的恶搞游戏。

top.title: Bid Boss
top.desc: Become the ultimate auction boss! Inspect storage units by flashlight, outbid sharp rivals and discover what’s hidden inside: junk, treasures… or a priceless jackpot.
top.descZh: 成为终极拍卖老板！用手电筒检查储物单元，与精明的对手竞价，发现里面藏着什么：垃圾、珍宝，还是无价的头奖。

top.title: Danish-Rules Lacrosse
top.desc: Another small atari-style game for mobile
top.descZh: 另一款面向移动端的小型雅达利复古风格游戏。

top.title: Stone Grass: Mowing Simulator
top.desc: Stone Grass: Mowing Simulator is a relaxing yet addictive game where you take control of a powerful mower and transform wild fields into perfectly trimmed landscapes. Glide smoothly through thick overgrowth, clearing grass with satisfying precision.
top.descZh: 《石头草地：割草模拟器》是一款轻松又上瘾的游戏，你操控一台强力割草机，把杂乱的荒地修整得整整齐齐。在茂密的杂草间顺畅滑行，以令人满足的精准度清除青草。

top.title: Ultimate Plane Upgrade
top.desc: Ultimate Plane Upgrade is a launch-and-upgrade flying game. Pull back the slingshot, release your plane and see how far it can glide.
top.descZh: 《终极飞机升级》是一款发射升级类飞行游戏。拉紧弹弓，放飞你的飞机，看它能滑翔多远。

top.title: Obby Steal an Egg
top.desc: Somebody has to steal that egg. It may as well be you.
top.descZh: 总得有人去偷那颗蛋。不如就你来吧。

top.title: Clean the Moon!
top.desc: Clean the Moon! is a relaxing 3D cleaning game on a small cratered moon.
top.descZh: 《清洁月球！》是一款轻松的 3D 清洁游戏，场景设在一颗布满陨石坑的小月球上。

top.title: Crack The Egg!
top.desc: A gigantic alien egg sits in the middle of a desert excavation site, and your job is to break it. Shoot its shell apart piece by piece with a futuristic blaster, scoop up the fragments, and sell them at the recycler for coins.
top.descZh: 一枚巨大的外星蛋矗立在沙漠挖掘现场中央，你的任务就是把它敲碎。用未来科技的能量枪把蛋壳一块块打碎，收集碎片，卖到回收站换金币。

top.title: Dig For The Lost Drive
top.desc: Dig for the lost drive is an arcade game where, in 2013, you mined 8,000 ByteNuggets on your old computer and wrote the wallet password on its 12 drives, and then the computer went to the dump. Today, 1 ByteNugget is worth $10,000: your wallet is worth $80,000,000!
top.descZh: 《挖掘失落的硬盘》是一款街机游戏。2013 年，你在旧电脑上挖出了 8000 个 ByteNugget，并把钱包密码写在它的 12 块硬盘上，后来这台电脑被扔进了垃圾堆。如今 1 个 ByteNugget 价值 1 万美元：你的钱包价值 8000 万美元！

top.title: Wild West City: Building Sim
top.desc: Welcome, Mayor, to Wild West City!Step into the boots of a pioneer and become the legendary founder of your very own Western town.
top.descZh: 欢迎来到西部之城，市长！化身拓荒者，成为你自己那座西部小镇的传奇缔造者。

top.title: Season Shift
top.desc: Shift the world
top.descZh: 改变世界。

top.title: Sweety Ludo
top.desc: Sweety Ludo is a charming blend of the traditional Ludo game with adorable 2D visuals. Challenge friends or global players in exciting multiplayer matches to collect candies and reign supreme!
top.descZh: 《甜蜜飞行棋》将传统飞行棋与可爱的 2D 画风巧妙融合。在精彩的多人对战中挑战好友或全球玩家，收集糖果，称霸全场！

top.title: World Z Defense - Zombie Defense
top.desc: World Z Defense - Zombie Defense is a thrilling action defense game where players must fight against hordes of zombies trying to overrun the world. In this post-apocalyptic scenario, your mission is to defend cities across the globe by strategically placing soldiers with different weapons, each offering unique stats like damage, shooting speed, and reload speed.
top.titleZh: 世界末日防御：僵尸守卫
top.descZh: 《世界末日防御：僵尸守卫》是一款刺激的动作防御游戏，玩家要对抗企图吞没世界的成群僵尸。在这个末日废土背景下，你的任务是策略性布置持不同武器的士兵，守住全球各地的城市——每种武器都有伤害、射速和装填速度等独特属性。

top.title: Train Simulator 3D
top.desc: Train Simulator 3D puts you in control of powerful trains across exciting railway routes!Experience life as a professional train driver with 5 different trains, 3 detailed routes, and 42 career missions.
top.descZh: 《3D 火车模拟器》让你驾驶强力列车驰骋在精彩的铁路线上！5 种不同列车、3 条精细路线、42 个生涯任务，体验专业火车司机的人生。

top.title: Canteen Rush
top.desc: Canteen Rush is a cozy, fast-paced canteen management game. You are the chef: grab fresh dishes from the cooking stations, stack them up, and fill the serving counter before the queue gets impatient.
top.descZh: 《食堂大作战》是一款轻松又节奏明快的食堂经营游戏。你是大厨：从烹饪台端起新鲜菜肴，叠放好，在排队的人失去耐心前把取餐台摆满。

top.title: Lumen
top.desc: Your light is the only thing keeping you alive, and it’s fading.In LUMEN, your glow is your health, your vision, and your weapon range all at once.
top.descZh: 你的光是唯一维系生命的东西，而它正在渐渐熄灭。在《流明》中，你的光芒同时就是生命值、视野和武器射程。

top.desc: 🎮 Something has awoken, rising from the Decay. Civilization has ended, and creatures older than man are slowly emerging from the depth of the earth. Vessels of Decay is a retro-inspired...

top.title: Screw Out: Bolts and Nuts
top.desc: Screw Out: Bolts and Nuts is a classic puzzle logic game where your goal is to unscrew bolts from various shapes and sort them by color into the correct containers. Each level presents a new challenge that requires patience, logic, and careful planning to succeed.
top.descZh: 经典解谜逻辑游戏，把各种形状上的螺栓拧下来，按颜色分类放进正确的容器。每关都是新挑战，需要耐心、逻辑和周密规划才能通关。

top.title: End of The Hallway
top.desc: no hard feelings
top.descZh: 没有恶意。

top.title: Spider Solitaire
top.desc: Spider Solitaire is a timeless card puzzle where strategy and precision lead to victory. Arrange cards in descending order from King to Ace within the same suit to clear the tableau.
top.descZh: 经久不衰的纸牌解谜游戏，策略与精准方能取胜。按同花色从 K 到 A 降序排列卡牌，清空牌面。

top.title: 8 Ball Pool Billiards Multiplayer
top.desc: 8 Ball Pool Billiards Multiplayer is a competitive sports pool game that lets you test your skills in exhilarating 2-player matches against friends or go head-to-head with players from around the world. Perfect your game by competing against expert bots to sharpen your strategies and techniques.
top.descZh: 竞技体育台球游戏，在刺激的双人对战中与朋友切磋，或与全球玩家一较高下。与高手机器人对战，磨练你的策略与技巧。

top.title: Real War: Not Fake
top.desc: Real War: Not Fake is an action shooting game where you lead an army down a scrolling battlefield ready to defend yourself on the front lines! Pick the right gates to walk through to build up your rewards and army so you can get to the very end alive.
top.descZh: 动作射击游戏，率领军队沿滚动的战场前进，在前线随时准备防御。选择合适的门通过，积累奖励和兵力，一路活着冲到最后。

top.title: PolyTrack
top.desc: PolyTrack is a classic car racing game with a slight twist. You race a car you've customized, on a track you might have designed yourself.
top.descZh: 经典赛车游戏，但略有新意：驾驶你亲手改装的车，在或许由你自己设计的赛道上飞驰。

top.title: Bid Boss
top.desc: Become the ultimate auction boss! Inspect storage units by flashlight, outbid sharp rivals and discover what’s hidden inside: junk, treasures… or a priceless jackpot.
top.descZh: 成为终极拍卖老板！用手电筒检查储物单元，与精明的对手竞价，发现里面藏着什么：垃圾、珍宝，还是无价的头奖。

top.title: Mini Golf Club
top.desc: Mini Golf Club is a multiplayer mini-golf game where you compete against real players across short, themed courses. Your objective is to sink the ball in as few strokes as possible before the timer runs out.
top.descZh: 多人迷你高尔夫游戏，在简短的主题球场上与真实玩家同场竞技。目标是在计时结束前用最少的杆数把球入洞。

top.title: Claw Master
top.desc: Claw Master is a unique arcade RPG that combines a claw machine, roguelike mechanics, and dungeon crawling into one exciting adventure. Control your claw, collect loot, discover powerful weapons, uncover hidden treasures, and explore dangerous dungeons filled with monsters and epic bosses.
top.descZh: 独特的街机 RPG，把抓娃娃机、Roguelike 机制和地下城探索融为一体。操控抓爪、收集战利品、发现强力武器、揭开隐藏宝藏，探索遍布怪物和史诗 Boss 的危险地下城。

top.title: Sky Riders
top.desc: Sky Riders is a high-speed casual vehicle driving game. Put your driving skills to the test as you complete several challenging tracks.
top.descZh: 高速休闲驾驶游戏。完成数条富有挑战性的赛道，测试你的驾驶技巧。

top.title: WorldGuessr Free GeoGuessr
top.desc: Worldguessr is a casual quiz game, a free alternative to Geoguessr, perfect for testing and expanding your geography skills through immersive Street View exploration. Each round, you will find yourself dropped into random locations around the globe, with only environmental clues to guide you in pinpointing your exact whereabouts.
top.descZh: 休闲问答游戏，是 Geoguessr 的免费替代品，通过沉浸式街景探索来测试和扩展地理知识。每轮你都会被投放到全球随机地点，只能靠环境线索推断自己的确切位置。

top.title: RocketGoal.io
top.desc: RocketGoal.io is an IO sports game where you drive around a soccer field to compete in intense matches against other players. Drive rocket-powered cars across the arena, show off wild aerial moves, and of course, score as many goals as possible.
top.descZh: IO 体育游戏，你驾驶汽车在足球场上与其他玩家展开激烈对决。开着火箭驱动的赛车驰骋球场，秀出狂野的空中特技，当然，还要尽可能多地进球！

top.title: Lumber Harvest: Tree Cutting Game
top.desc: Lumber Harvest: Tree Cutting Game is a relaxing progression game where you drive a powerful tractor to clear forests and collect timber. You’ll upgrade your saw, expand your truck’s capacity, and unlock new areas as you turn trees into profit.
top.descZh: 轻松的养成游戏，驾驶强力拖拉机清理森林、收集木材。升级电锯、扩容卡车、解锁新区域，把树木变成利润。

top.title: Forgotten Treasure 2
top.desc: Forgotten Treasure 2 is a puzzle game where you combine jewels to crash obstacles using your logic and go through numerous challenges. At the moment, there are more than a thousand levels and this is far from the limit.
top.descZh: 益智游戏，运用逻辑消除宝石、击碎障碍，闯过重重挑战。目前已有上千关卡，而且远未到尽头。

top.title: Dead Land: Survival
top.desc: Dead Land: Survival is a survival horror game set in a zombie-infested apocalyptic world where you fight for survival with powerful skills you accumulate throughout gameplay. Fortify your shelter against relentless undead attacks and scavenge through desolate territories in search of valuable resources.
top.descZh: 生存恐怖游戏，背景是丧尸横行的末日世界，你在游戏中积累强大技能、为生存而战。加固庇护所抵御亡灵的持续进攻，在荒芜之地搜寻宝贵资源。

top.title: Farm Ring Idle
top.desc: Farm Ring Idle is a circular farming simulation that challenges you to expand outward from a tiny central plot into a thriving, automated ring of crops. Grow vegetables, unlock smart upgrades, and deploy robotic helpers to streamline your harvest.
top.descZh: 环形农场模拟游戏，从中心的小块地向外扩张，发展成自动化种植的繁荣环形农场。种植蔬菜、解锁智能升级、部署机器人助手，让收获更轻松。

top.title: Bus Escape: Clear Jam
top.desc: Dismantle the bus and send the passengers home in this colorful parking puzzle that delivers both fun and a brain workout. Combining simple gameplay with increasing difficulty, the game is perfect for fans of strategic puzzles and driving simulators.
top.descZh: 色彩缤纷的停车解谜游戏，拆开巴士、送乘客回家，既有趣又烧脑。玩法简单、难度递增，非常适合策略解谜和驾驶模拟爱好者。

top.title: Table Tennis World Tour
top.desc: Table Tennis World Tour is a thrilling sports game where you compete in table tennis matches against various opponents.Choose your country and step into the global arena, where you'll face off against a diverse array of opponents from around the world.
top.descZh: 刺激的体育游戏，与不同对手进行乒乓球比赛。选择你的国家，登上全球赛场，与来自世界各地的各路对手过招。

top.title: Favorite Puzzles
top.desc: Favorite Puzzles is a free jigsaw puzzle game with a wide selection of beautiful images to suit everyone. This game is designed to give you the ultimate puzzle-solving experience.
top.descZh: 免费的拼图游戏，提供大量精美图片，适合所有人。游戏旨在为你带来极致的拼图解谜体验。

top.title: Hidden Object: Clues and Mysteries
top.desc: Hidden Object: Clues and Mysteries is a charming puzzle game that invites players to uncover secrets hidden within cozy, beautifully illustrated scenes. Follow a calm and clever detective as your guide while you explore each setting, searching for concealed items, solving gentle puzzles, and connecting mysterious clues.
top.descZh: 迷人的解谜游戏，邀请玩家在温馨精美的场景中发现隐藏的秘密。跟随一位冷静聪慧的侦探，探索每个场景，寻找隐藏物品、解开谜题、串联神秘线索。

top.title: Virtual Sealing
top.desc: Another small atari-style game for mobile
top.descZh: 另一款面向移动端的小型雅达利复古风格游戏。

top.title: Elsewild
top.desc: A massive open world survival adventure in an endless world.
top.descZh: 一款在无尽世界中展开的大型开放世界生存冒险游戏。

top.title: My Beautiful Son
top.desc: Collect food for your new found son in a dangerous forest
top.descZh: 在危险的森林里为你新出生的儿子收集食物。

top.title: Prism Break
top.desc: Help light reach the gate in this monochromatic world.
top.descZh: 在这个单色世界中引导光线抵达大门。

top.title: Slightly scary Adventure of Dummy-Garry
top.desc: Help Garry to solve puzzles with keyboard and mouse
top.descZh: 用键盘和鼠标帮助加里解开谜题。

top.title: The Nick Senny Ritual
top.desc: Fight the Nick Senemies
top.descZh: 与「尼克敌人」战斗。

top.title: Waha's Cleaning Service of Terror
top.desc: It's just a little cleaning job. What could go wrong?
top.descZh: 这只是份小小的清洁工作，能出什么问题呢？

top.title: Tenfold
top.desc: Collect and battle strange horiffic creatures in this RPG roguelike!
top.descZh: 在这款 RPG Roguelike 中收集并战斗奇异可怕的怪物！
